summary: Loads pit crew animation MAS files for the current vehicle/track context. Runs only when the scoring gate dword_8AB6E4 is not 2 and either the target vehicle is the player vehicle (dword_7C54E8) or the detail level dword_7CF884 is >= 3. Builds directory-relative file paths from byte_5EA438 with per-track subdirectory names, allocates the pit crew 10sec, normal and (player-only) pit director animation objects, stores them in this[4], this[3] and this[5], then frees temporary buffers and returns the arithmetic comparison of the argument struct.
